info.title: Marchlands API
info.description: Marchlands game server, based on Evony Age 1. Successful calls answer `{ ok: 1, data }`; failures `{ ok: <negative code>, error: { code, params } }` with a 4xx status: a message code the client words in the language the player chose. Live updates (`server.*` pushes of the original protocol) arrive on the WebSocket at `/ws?token=...` as `{ cmd, data }`.
